evaluation.summary: Freeze Writer-owned New prepopulation by canonical semantic field identity and role. The latest tutorial is the source when one exists; a target field is copied only when that source type carries the same canonical semantic field/role. Otherwise retain the already-validated New-form default. Never infer provenance from equal values or invent Initial/current cross-role promotion, and do not add network-write or teacher-reassignment authority.

source_authority.new_form: structural/default authority for requested type, authenticated teacher, default date, and fields not carried from the latest source
source_authority.stale_rule: If a fresh read shows a different latest tutorial identity before create, the New draft is stale and must be rebuilt/reconciled; never silently rebind.

global_rules.tutorial_date: always use validated New-form customdate default; never copy historical tutorial_date
global_rules.teacher: always use immutable validated New-form teacher
global_rules.absent: copy latest absent when source exists; otherwise New-form default
global_rules.overall_level: copy latest overall level when source exists; otherwise New-form default
global_rules.teacher_comments: copy latest teacher comments when source exists; otherwise New-form default
global_rules.semantic_identity: GEL field IDs and semantic roles are authoritative; equal values in unrelated dimensions never establish provenance

level_projection.initial_target_role: copy latest Initial-role value only when the source type carries the same canonical Initial field (Initial/Final); otherwise New-form default
level_projection.current_target_role: copy latest current-role value only when the source type carries the same canonical current field (Standard/Final); otherwise New-form default
level_projection.reading: copy latest Reading when the source type carries Reading (Standard/Final); otherwise New-form default; there is no Initial Reading field
level_projection.forbidden: No cross-dimension fallback or inference and no Initial/current cross-role promotion. Equal values never establish provenance.

initial.initial_scores: same canonical Initial-role field or New-form default
initial.exam: copy only from latest Initial source; otherwise New-form defaults

standard.current_scores: same canonical current-role field or New-form default
standard.self_assessment: copy only from latest Standard source; otherwise New-form defaults
standard.aims: copy only from latest Standard source; otherwise New-form default

final.initial_scores: same canonical Initial-role field or New-form default
final.current_scores: same canonical current-role field or New-form default
final.additional_comments: copy only from latest Final source; otherwise New-form default

source_vs_derived.derived_projection: field-by-field New defaults according to this contract
source_vs_derived.semantic_state: TutorialFormState with DraftOrigin::New; produced only after projection succeeds
source_vs_derived.payload: later derived by rust_post_mapper; N2c grants no network write

failure_semantics: Latest source student_uid different from New-form student_uid -> fail closed.
Latest source identity must be canonical positive when present -> fail closed.
Validated New-form type/teacher authority remains binding; N2c cannot override either.
Type-inapplicable state remains empty under semantic validation.
No cross-dimension, equal-value, or Initial/current cross-role provenance inference is permitted.
No tutorial_id/tutorial_ts is invented for New.
No GEL network write authority is introduced.
deferred_non_blocking: changed-teacher serialization and server reassignment are permanently unsupported in production Writer

canonical_level_fields.rule: Use these semantic identities only; do not infer cross-skill provenance from equal values.
